author: GamingBolt
description:
In part one of our Plague Tale series, we covered the events of Innocence. Here in part two, we will now tackle the sequel: Requiem. If “Innocence” was the precursor to the de Rune siblings' exposure to their world's horrors and what it meant to fend for themselves against overwhelming odds, A Plague Tale: Requiem expands upon that nightmare. Released in October 2022, it took everything from the original and built on it in meaningful ways, but the situation Amicia and Hugo find themselves in is on another level entirely.

Once dreaming of becoming a knight, Amicia has slotted into the role of a protector for her younger brother...except she's learning the hard way that there's no room for nobility in the mud. It's kill or be killed, and she's only gotten better at it. Hugo is still at odds with the Macula in his blood, even if he doesn't realize it, but there's an air about him - almost a sad acceptance that he won't ever be “normal,” coupled with a fire to change this.
title: A Plague Tale: Requiem - The Full Story - Before You Play Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy

author: GamingBolt
description:
If you thought combat is a big part of Mortal Shell 2, you’re certainly right. Or perhaps you’ve been hooked by the new and improved version of the game's world? Also a solid reason to dive in. But there’s something that brings it all together, making your character’s unique relationships with the Shells of a multitude of warriors become a build crafting engine that refuses to drop its momentum once it gets going.

We’re talking about the Tarstones. Each one you find out there in the world has the potential to pull you out of the action and into a build-crafting system that keeps you occupied for a while before you head out, come back and repeat the cycle.
title: Mortal Shell 2's Most Addictive Gameplay Mechanic Isn't What You Think

author: GamingBolt
description:
It’s almost time to get back on the courts in NBA 2K27, and Visual Concepts is shaping this year’s innovations around community feedback. Authenticity, competition, balance – these pillars, and more, are where the studio is focusing its effort, aiming to enhance the basketball simulation in ways which mean the most to players. 

Will it be endless alley-oops or ankle breakers? Here’s fifteen things you need to know before you buy NBA 2K27.
title: NBA 2K27 - 14 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
